_comment: AgentHost starter stack -- the curated set of skills every box boots with. start.sh merges the plugin entries below into ~/.claude/settings.json on first boot (a user's own same-named entry always wins). The `skills` CLI reads this file to show the inventory. Sources verified real 2026-07-18; several are proven working in the AgentHost dev harness. `plugins` install via settings.json (extraKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins). `mcp` entries install their own way (a setup command) and are flagged. `setup` names what a user must still do for a skill to fully work; null = works out of the box.

plugins.name: Superpowers
plugins.blurb: Disciplined planning, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, and verification-before-done skills.

plugins.name: AgentMemory
plugins.blurb: Persistent memory that carries decisions and project state across every model you use.

plugins.name: Claude Ads
plugins.blurb: Paid-media operations across 12 ad platforms: audits, plans, creative, brand DNA, PPC math.

plugins.name: Claude SEO
plugins.blurb: Technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, backlinks, local + international SEO.

plugins.name: Claude Blog
plugins.blurb: SEO- and AI-citation-optimized blog writing with a structured delivery contract.

plugins.name: Marketing Skills
plugins.blurb: 60 skills for technical founders: CRO, copywriting, cold email, pricing, launches, PR, positioning.

skills.name: Newsjacking
skills.blurb: Monitor trends in real time, score brand-relevant opportunities, generate rapid-response content.

skills.name: Pitch Deck Mastery
skills.blurb: Investor-grade pitch decks from 10 curated startup resources and proven deck structures.

mcp.name: CodeGraph
mcp.blurb: A local code knowledge graph so agents waste less context rereading the same files.
mcp.setup: run `codegraph init` inside a repo to index it

keyGated.name: Higgsfield
keyGated.blurb: Image + video generation (HyperFrames-adjacent). Ships enabled on this box.
keyGated.setup: add your Higgsfield API key to use it (image/video generation is a paid service)
